methodology.workload: CoreMark 2K performance seeds, one context, fixed compile-time iterations
methodology.process: one new module and JIT per sample; cases rotate between fresh-process rounds
methodology.timing: Run wall time excludes module load, RAM setup and JIT construction; includes cold compilation and publication
methodology.kernel: guest microsecond timer around CoreMark iterate; includes JIT misses and engine tiering; no steady-state claim
methodology.duration: durationQualified requires every guest sample to meet the upstream 10-second minimum; not certification
methodology.reference: native executable validates CRCs, including final CRC; native timing is not a performance comparison

collection: Paired per case, case order rotated and build order alternated each round; every sample requires ten seconds
